name: What preparation do I need to do before basement molding installation?

mainEntity.name: What preparation do I need to do before basement molding installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before our team arrives for basement molding installation, ensure the area is clear of furniture, personal items, and any wall hangings. Walls should be clean and dry. If you plan to paint the molding a specific color, deciding on the paint or having it ready can help streamline the process. For new construction or renovation, ensure all drywall work is complete. Providing easy access to electrical outlets and a clear workspace helps our installers work efficiently and safely.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the area of furniture, ensure walls are clean and dry, and provide easy access for installers.
